# Meeting Notes

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **macOS 14.2+ Required for Audio Recording**
> Dual-track system audio + microphone recording uses **macOS Core Audio Process Tap** & **AVFoundation** (`MeetingRecorder.app`). Windows and Linux can still browse, search, and manage existing meeting notes and transcripts, while local recording requires macOS 14.2+ and Xcode Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --install`).

## Overview

**Meeting Notes** is a local meeting recorder, dual-track speaker timeline generator, and structured Markdown notes plugin for **Google Antigravity**:

- **Dual-Track & Mic-Only Capture**: Record global macOS system audio alongside your microphone (compatible with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Feishu/Lark, Tencent Meeting, and browser calls), or record microphone-only voice notes.
- **No Prebuilt Unsigned Binaries (Local Setup)**: To keep the plugin clean and avoid Apple Gatekeeper quarantine prompts, no precompiled `.app` or `.node` binaries are bundled. Click **Initialize Local Recorder** in the side pane on first use (about 20–40 seconds) to compile `MeetingRecorder.app` locally into your plugin data directory (`${PLUGIN_DATA}/bin/`).
- **Bilingual UI (EN / 中文)**: Switch between **English** (default) and **Chinese** anytime from the top bar; preference is saved locally per workspace profile.
- **Background Daemon & Resumable Transcription**: Recording continues reliably in the background across Antigravity conversation switches and handles device changes or lid-close finalization. Trigger `meeting-notes` from the side pane to transcribe chunks with checkpoints and render full GFM Markdown notes.

## Privacy & Data Flow

- **100% Local Storage**: Audio chunks (`.m4a`), speaker timelines (`timelines/*.json`), transcripts, and Markdown notes live strictly on your machine under `${PLUGIN_DATA}/meetings/` (nothing is uploaded to any third-party recording cloud).
- **On-Demand Model Access**: Audio chunks are only read by the agent when you explicitly click **Generate Notes** or invoke the `meeting-notes` skill / MCP tools.
- **Configurable Retention**: Keep raw `.m4a` files manually, auto-clean them after notes finish, or expire raw audio after 7 days while preserving notes and transcripts.

## macOS Permissions

Before your first recording, grant `MeetingRecorder` access under **System Settings → Privacy & Security**:

1. **Microphone** (required for all recording modes).
2. **Screen & System Audio Recording → System Audio Recording Only** (required for Dual-Track mode).

## Starter Prompts

- `Open the Meeting Notes side pane and start recording a meeting`
- `Transcribe my most recent meeting and generate structured notes with action items`
- `Search past meeting notes and transcripts for budget or architecture decisions`

# Meeting Notes

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 面向 **Google Antigravity** 的本地会议录制、双轨说话人时间线与结构化 Markdown 会议纪要插件（MCP App + Skill + Native Swift Recorder）。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **音频录制仅支持 macOS 14.2+（macOS Only）**
> 本项目底层音频采集深度依赖 **macOS Core Audio Process Tap**、**AVFoundation** 与 **Swift**（`MeetingRecorder.app`）。在 Windows 或 Linux 上可安全启动 MCP Server 并浏览/搜索已有历史纪要与逐字稿，界面会提示「仅支持 macOS」，不会崩溃；**本地实时录音与原音采集需要 macOS 14.2+ 与 Xcode Command Line Tools**。

---

## 环境要求（Requirements）

- **操作系统（录音功能）**：macOS 14.2（Sonoma）或更高版本
- **编译工具链**：Xcode Command Line Tools（`xcode-select --install`，含 Swift 与 `cc` / `codesign`）
- **运行时**：Node.js 22+
- **宿主客户端**：Google Antigravity（支持插件、MCP Apps 侧边栏与 Skills）

---

## 核心特性

- **零预编译未签名二进制（Marketplace Ready / 方案 B）**：
  - 插件分发包（`npm run build:plugin`）仅包含前端单页 HTML（`plugin/ui/app.html`）、可执行 MCP Server（`plugin/scripts/meeting-mcp-server.mjs`）、Skill 与可读 Swift/C 源码（`plugin/sources/`），**不随包分发未签名 `.app` 或 `.node` 二进制**。
  - 首次在 macOS 侧边栏使用时，点击 **Initialize Local Recorder（初始化本机录音组件）**，插件会在 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/bin/` 中本机编译并签名 `MeetingRecorder.app`（及可选原生安全文件模块 `safe_openat.node`），彻底避免跨机 Gatekeeper 拦截与签名失效。
  - 内置纯 Node.js 安全降级实现，即使未编译 `safe_openat.node` 或运行在非 macOS 环境也能安全启动与防符号链接读写。
- **双语切换与快捷管理**：
  - 顶栏提供 **EN / 中** 切换按钮（默认英文 `en`），偏好持久化保存在服务端 `settings.json`。
  - 录制页「最近录制（Recent Recordings）」列表中，每条记录的 **View Details（查看详情）** 后紧邻 **Delete（删除）** 按钮，需二次点击 **Confirm Delete（确认删除）** 后执行，防止误删。
- **双轨 / 单轨高质量录制与说话人时间线**：
  - **双轨模式（`dual`）**：同步采集全局系统音频（对方）与本地麦克风（我方），兼容 Zoom、Google Meet、Teams、飞书、腾讯会议及浏览器会议；生成混音（`mix_*.m4a`）、分轨（`mic_*.m4a`、`remote_*.m4a`）和说话人时间线（`timelines/chunk_*.json`）。
  - **仅麦克风模式（`mic`）**：适用于线下沟通或个人语音速记。
- **后台独立守护与断点续转**：
  - `MeetingRecorder.app` 独立常驻运行，支持 5 分钟滚动切片、音频设备切换自动重连与缺口（`gaps`）记录、合盖休眠安全封包。
  - 一键在新独立会话触发 `meeting-notes` 技能按片转写，超过 4 片自动启用只读子 Agent 分组并发转写并在主 Agent 串行校验汇总。
- **完整 GFM Markdown 渲染与原音频留存策略**：
  - 内置 XSS 安全的 GitHub 风格 Markdown 渲染器，支持 Alerts、行动项表格、任务清单、代码块与深浅色自适应。
  - 支持「永久保留（手动清理）」「生成纪要后自动清理」「保留 7 天」三种策略；所有数据默认保存在本机，不上传任何第三方录音云。

---

## 快速安装（Quick Start）

> 在 **macOS 14.2+** 终端中执行以下命令安装插件（插件目录默认为 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/meeting-notes`，Manifest `name` 为 `meeting-notes`，显示名 `Meeting Notes`）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nolinsun/meeting-notes.git
cd meeting-notes
npm install

# 可选（推荐）：创建本机代码签名证书 "Local Meeting Recorder"
# 可帮助 macOS TCC 在重建或升级后尽量保留麦克风/系统录音权限
bash recorder-macos/scripts/setup-local-cert.sh

# 方式 A：标准开发安装（本机全量编译 UI、MCP Server、原生扩展与 MeetingRecorder.app，并原子安装）
npm run install:plugin

# 方式 B：纯粹按 Marketplace / 方案 B 打包安装（不预置 plugin/bin 二进制，由侧边栏首次点击本机编译）
bash scripts/install-plugin.sh --option-b
```

安装完成后，在 Google Antigravity 右侧边栏 **「+」菜单** 或全局面板打开 **Meeting Notes**，或直接对 Agent 说：

- `Open the Meeting Notes side pane and start recording a meeting`
- `整理最近一场会议并生成结构化纪要和待办事项`

---

## macOS 权限配置

首次录制前，请在 macOS **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性** 中为 `MeetingRecorder` 开启：

1. **麦克风**（双轨与仅麦克风模式均必需）。
2. **录屏与系统录音 → 仅系统音频录制（System Audio Recording Only）**（双轨模式必需）。

> [!TIP]
> 侧边栏「Audio Permissions & Devices / 音频权限与设备」面板提供权限检测、隐私设置直达与「重启并重检」按钮。由于无开发者签名切换为 `io.github.nolinsun.meeting-recorder` 或首次本机编译时，如之前曾为旧包授权过，建议按提示重新开启开关并点击「Restart & Recheck」。

---

# Meeting Notes

[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

> A local **macOS** meeting recorder, dual-track speaker timeline generator, and structured Markdown meeting notes plugin (MCP App + Skill + Native Swift Recorder) for **Google Antigravity**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **macOS 14.2+ Required for Audio Recording**
> Dual-track system audio and microphone capture relies directly on **macOS Core Audio Process Tap**, **AVFoundation**, and **Swift** (`MeetingRecorder.app`). Windows and Linux can still run the MCP server safely to browse, search, and manage existing meeting notes and transcripts (showing a clear macOS-only banner for recording), while **audio capture requires macOS 14.2+ and Xcode Command Line Tools**.

---

## Requirements

- **Operating System (Recording)**: macOS 14.2 (Sonoma) or later
- **Build Toolchain**: Xcode Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --install`, including Swift, `cc`, and `codesign`)
- **Runtime**: Node.js 22+
- **Host Client**: Google Antigravity (supporting plugins, MCP Apps side pane / global view, and Skills)

---

## Key Features

- **Zero Unsigned Binaries in Plugin Bundles (Marketplace-Ready / Option B)**:
  - `npm run build:plugin` packages only the single-file UI (`plugin/ui/app.html`), executable MCP server (`plugin/scripts/meeting-mcp-server.mjs`), `meeting-notes` skill, and inspectable Swift/C sources (`plugin/sources/`). **No unsigned `.app` or `.node` binaries are distributed inside the plugin bundle.**
  - On first launch on macOS, clicking **Initialize Local Recorder** in the side pane compiles and locally signs `MeetingRecorder.app` (plus optional native helper `safe_openat.node`) directly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/bin/`, keeping `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` read-only and avoiding cross-machine Gatekeeper quarantine issues.
  - Built-in pure-Node.js fallback keeps symlink-safe file operations working even without compiled native addons or on non-macOS hosts.
- **Bilingual UI Toggle & Quick Delete**:
  - Top-bar **EN / 中** language switcher (default **English**), persisted server-side in `settings.json`.
  - **Recent Recordings** on the **Record** tab includes a **Delete** button immediately after **View Details**, requiring an inline **Confirm Delete** click before deleting.
- **Dual-Track & Mic-Only Recording with Speaker Timelines**:
  - **Dual-track (`dual`)**: Captures global macOS system audio (remote participants) plus your microphone (local speaker) for Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Feishu/Lark, Tencent Meeting, and browser calls, producing mixed (`mix_*.m4a`), mic (`mic_*.m4a`), remote (`remote_*.m4a`) audio and speaker timelines (`timelines/chunk_*.json`).
  - **Mic-only (`mic`)**: Lightweight capture for in-person discussions or voice memos.
- **Independent Background Daemon & Resumable Transcription**:
  - `MeetingRecorder.app` runs independently in the background across Antigravity sessions with 5-minute rolling chunks, audio device change handling, gap tracking, and safe finalization before sleep/lid-close.
  - One-click **Generate Notes** launches a dedicated session using the `meeting-notes` skill (sequential per-chunk checkpointing for <= 4 chunks; parallel read-only subagent fan-out for > 4 chunks).
- **XSS-Safe GFM Markdown Viewer & Local Retention Policies**:
  - Renders alerts/callouts, Action Items tables, fenced code blocks, nested/task lists, and adapts automatically to light/dark themes.
  - Raw audio retention modes (`manual`, `after_notes`, `days_7`) never delete untranscribed audio automatically.

---

## Quick Start

> Run in a **macOS 14.2+** terminal to install locally (default plugin dir `~/.gemini/config/plugins/meeting-notes`, manifest `name: "meeting-notes"`, `displayName: "Meeting Notes"`):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nolinsun/meeting-notes.git
cd meeting-notes
npm install

# Optional (recommended): create local codesign cert "Local Meeting Recorder"
# to help macOS TCC retain Microphone / System Audio permissions across rebuilds
bash recorder-macos/scripts/setup-local-cert.sh

# Option A (Dev full build): compile UI, MCP server, native addon, and MeetingRecorder.app,
# then install atomically to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/meeting-notes
npm run install:plugin

# Option B (Marketplace-style local setup): install without prebuilt binaries under plugin/bin/;
# compile MeetingRecorder.app on demand via "Initialize Local Recorder" in the side pane
bash scripts/install-plugin.sh --option-b
```

Open **Meeting Notes** from Google Antigravity's side pane **"+"** menu (or global view), or prompt the agent directly:

- `Open the Meeting Notes side pane and start recording a meeting`
- `Transcribe my most recent meeting and generate structured notes with action items`
- `Search past meeting notes and transcripts for budget or architecture decisions`

---

## macOS Permissions

Before recording for the first time, grant access to `MeetingRecorder` in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**:

1. **Microphone** (required for both Dual-Track and Mic-Only modes).
2. **Screen & System Audio Recording → System Audio Recording Only** (required for Dual-Track mode).

> [!TIP]
> Use the **Audio Permissions & Devices** strip in the side pane (**Check Permissions**, **Privacy Settings**, **Restart & Recheck**) to diagnose audio permissions at any time.

---
